target_customer: DevOps and platform engineering teams on AWS and GCP using Terraform
problem: Writing least privilege IAM policies by hand is slow and error prone, so teams over-permission; Slauth generated and rightsized policies in pull requests.

founders.name: Tal Auslander
previous_startups: SignifAI (acquired by New Relic, per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs code analysis of cloud SDK usage and IaC integration; LLM assistance later simplified generation.

defensibility.rationale: Open source CLI and easy replication by cloud security vendors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AWS offered policy generation from CloudTrail logs; the company was instead acquired by Ark Infotech around December 2023 per CB Insights.

market_need_then: Cloud permission sprawl and least privilege were widely cited security concerns, but no dated demand evidence was collected for 2022.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand, and the name is hard to say or spell.

outcome_analysis: Three experienced founders with prior exits built an IAM policy copilot, raised a small seed in 2022, and were reportedly acquired by Ark Infotech in December 2023 or January 2024. Acquisition terms and reasons are not public, so whether it was a soft landing or a success is unknown.
notes: Funding conflicts: CB Insights total 500K, another database 1.2M across 2 rounds; both rounds rest on single databases and the 2023-02 label is unknown. Acquisition date conflicts (December 2023 vs January 2024), rests on CB Insights. YC website field is blank. A Launch HN dated December 2023 names Wiz as an incumbent but is outside the batch window, so no competitors recorded. Axiom's 7M seed is a different company.
